description: Record that a value was FITTED to a piece of evidence, so that same evidence can no longer count as its validation (CALIBRATED_AGAINST). Use it for any empirically-calibrated value — a coefficient fitted to a published anchor, a constant tuned to a dataset, a model matched to a measurement. Agreement with that evidence afterwards is a FIT, NOT A TEST, and `evidence_report` marks any check resting on it as consumed and excludes it from independent evidence. This has to be recorded rather than detected: no check inside a design can establish its own independence, so nothing can find the circularity by analysis. Also a traceability edge — correcting the anchor puts every value fitted to it in the blast radius.

calibrated_at.description: When the fit was made, if recorded. The core takes no clock.

evidence_type.description:
`Artifact` (a published anchor, a dataset, a measurement record) or
`Verification` (the check whose output the value was fitted to).

from_type.description:
Node type of the value that was fitted (e.g. `Capability`, `Artifact`,
`Component`, `Constraint`).

note.description:
What was fitted, and how — the part a later reader needs in order to
judge whether the fit still stands.

name: calibrated_against
